_purpose: Harvest-pair map for the EOY-2026 TLH campaign (runbook amendment 2026-08-21). Every core slot + the two index funds gets a wash-safe rotation partner and an ETF fallback. Built against Parametric bundle 2026-08-14 (527 symbols, msprime.db latest reporting_date).
_doctrine: Primary partner where the 8/02 ruled pair survives validation; PARTNER_SWAPPED where it collided with the Parametric surface or was structurally unsound.

PARAMETRIC_SELF (7 slots: CI CTSH EQT KNSL MCK WRB XOM): harvesting OUR lot is washed if Parametric BUYS the name within +/-30d of our loss sale -> pull Parametric trade file for the name before every harvest batch.
PARAMETRIC_TARGET rule: never rotate INTO a Parametric-held single (our buy can wash THEIR loss sale) -> those partners were swapped to ETFs.
CORE_MUTUAL swaps (A->B while B->A) are wash-legal (neither repurchases the security it sold); the temporary slot-cap overweight during the 31-day window is authorized by this map.
OPTIONS_OVERLAY: no stock harvest while short options live on the name (EQT short puts; WAL if Template-3 CCs ever open).
31-day clock on every rotation; return to the original name is optional, not required - if the partner is doing the job, stay.
No ETF used here appears on the Parametric surface (verified 2026-08-21).
